summary: Gabled L-4 cabin in the Umatilla National Forest, dated 1941; removed or destroyed in 1964, though a 1966 report describes closing. Gone; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: Gabled L-4 cabin with a garage
facts.status_note: Gone; sources disagree on whether it was removed in 1964 or closed in 1966

events.note: Oregon lookout history says the lookout was built and manned first about 1926; no detail on that structure

notes_for_editor: Build date conflict: 1941 (register and Firelookout.com) vs first built and manned about 1926 (Oregon history page); the story says the sources do not explain the gap. End date conflict: removed or destroyed 1964 vs a July 1966 closing item. The record's kind 'ground' fits a cabin on the ground. Access not found in any source read, so no access or visit facts. One web search returned a Wolf Mountain Lookout Site snippet with 1941 and 1964 dates; it names a different site and was not used.
